entrypoints.description: Memory campaign application primitives own blind/search separation and bounded saturation/depth rules.
Typed reader exposes current Memory disagreement, research-only hypothesis and explicit model-memory coverage state without promoting them into historical truth.

extension_seams: Add orthogonal recall/search families without weakening the sealed blind/search boundary or forcing uncertain memory into false precision.
Add cross-model refresh/backfill evaluation as a new instrument vintage, not overwrite.

Expose explicit current research-only disagreement/hypothesis/coverage state through typed readers while preserving its non-Evidence authority class, own-run industry provenance and sealed-campaign vintage.

guards.description: Blind-recall prompt regression preserves fragmentary memory and approximate periods instead of rewarding exact-looking dates.
Typed memory ingest accepts open-ended approximate periods while keeping precision risk explicit.
Researcher projection test keeps current research state opt-in, non-historical and scoped by current research provenance rather than the historical membership cutoff.

PostgreSQL smoke proves current Memory disagreement/hypothesis scope comes from the research run, and model-memory coverage comes only from the latest sealed campaign while newer unsealed campaign state is excluded.

non_goals: Presenting current research disagreement/hypothesis/model-memory coverage state as historical market knowledge.
Constraining current research state to entities visible in an arbitrary historical membership snapshot.
Mixing coverage cells across model-memory campaign vintages or treating an unsealed campaign as a final current coverage view.
Treating model-memory coverage cells as proof that the archive or the real world lacks an event.
Forcing fragmentary recollection into exact dates or dropping useful leads because their time is only approximate.
purpose: Own blind memory-exhaustion, sealing, post-seal verification and the explicitly research-only state that remains around Memory Leads: disagreement cases, hypothesis assessments and model-memory campaign coverage. Current research scope comes from its own run/subject provenance; researcher-facing coverage uses one latest sealed campaign vintage rather than mixing campaigns. These states guide research but remain below Evidence authority and are never backdated into historical market knowledge.
revisit_when: Only replace if blind recall, approximate/uncertain lead preservation, immutable seal, campaign-vintage provenance, search-enabled verification, explicit current research uncertainty and Evidence-final authority remain auditable and append-only.
title: Historical model-memory campaign and verification
